map.最大升阻比对应什么速度？: What speed does the maximum L/D correspond to?
map.对应阻力最小时的速度（阻力极曲线最低点），也是燃油里程最佳点。偏离（更快或更慢）: It corresponds to the speed of minimum drag (the lowest point of the drag polar), which is also the best fuel-mileage point. Off it (faster or slower) the L/D falls and the range shortens.
map.升阻比：L/D = 升力系数 C_L ÷ 阻力系数 C_D；联动量：阻力占比 =: Lift-to-drag ratio: L/D = lift coefficient C_L ÷ drag coefficient C_D; linked values: drag share = C_D ÷ C_L × 100 (%), glide angle = arctan(C_D÷C_L)×180/π (°), lift share = C_L ÷ (C_L+C_D) × 100 (%), lift-to-drag percentage = (L/D)×100. Validation: C_L and C_D are required guards, and C_D as the denominator must not be 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the larger L/D, the higher the aerodynamic efficiency and the shallower the unpowered glide angle.
